title: Pocketwire Rewards Desk Note on Suspension, Reinstatement and Closure of Memberships
content:
A Pocketwire Rewards membership is suspended while its linked Pocketwire Personal Account is limited or locked, or when the risk team confirms rewards abuse, and the reason recorded on the suspension decides whether it can be reinstated.

## Rules

1. A membership is suspended with the reason linked account restricted while the linked personal account is limited or locked.
2. A membership is suspended with the reason rewards abuse when the risk team confirms self-referral or manufactured spend.
3. A membership suspended for linked account restricted is reinstated when the personal account returns to active.
4. A membership suspended for rewards abuse is never reinstated and is closed with its points forfeited.
5. While suspended, purchases earn no points and none can be redeemed, and missed earnings are never credited back after reinstatement.
6. A membership whose linked personal account closes is closed on the same day.

## Suspension reasons at a glance

| Suspension reason | Recorded when | Ends by |
|---|---|---|
| linked account restricted | the linked personal account is limited or locked | reinstatement when the personal account returns to active |
| rewards abuse | the risk team confirms self-referral or manufactured spend | closure with the points forfeited; never reinstated |

## Membership statuses

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| enrolled | joined, no points yet credited |
| active | the first points have been credited |
| suspended | earning and redemption stopped |
| closed | membership ended; remaining points forfeited |

## Points of judgement

- A purchase made during a suspension for linked account restricted earns nothing, and after reinstatement it is not credited back.
- A member whose linked personal account has returned to active after a lock has a suspension reason that no longer holds; the membership is reinstated.
- A membership suspended for rewards abuse stays out of reach of reinstatement even if the personal account is active.
